title: Journaling Sentiment Drift
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=journal:entry
| timechart span=1w avg(sentiment_score) as sentiment
| eventstats avg(sentiment) as base, stdev(sentiment) as sd
| eval dip=if(sentiment<base-sd,1,0)
description: Trends the overall sentiment of your journal entries and flags a sustained dip in tone worth noticing.
value: A gradual darkening in your own writing is hard to see up close; a sentiment trend surfaces it kindly and early.
implementation: Ingest per-entry sentiment scores into `index=personal`; alert on a sustained downward drift.
visualization: Line chart of journal sentiment over time with a dip band.
grandmaExplanation: It notices when the overall tone of your journal drifts sad over time, which is worth gently paying attention to.
